answer: Agents wander across tasks. Each epoch a comet beacon sweeps the registry, naming 1-in-8. A named agent gets 15 minutes to post a key-signed heartbeat proving 20 seconds of work. Tied to the beacon's fresh value, it cannot be precomputed or replayed; a borrowed heartbeat burns its bond and its lender's too. First fake 38, k-th 38+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,034,000 plus 70,000 locked vs 40,000 pool. An honest agent answers once for 38, bond kept.
